subject: weekly-update-announcement-contract
scope: Every active subject's weekly-update announcement must embed the complete, verified upcoming weekly agenda. Permanent weekly workflow, not a one-off.

structure.2: Concise recap of the week just completed, when appropriate.
structure.3: Concise preview of important upcoming instruction, assessments, resources, or reminders.
structure.4: Transition, e.g. 'The Canvas Math page has been updated. Please see the upcoming week ahead.' (substitute the subject name).
structure.5: Embed the complete, verified upcoming weekly agenda HTML exactly as rendered on that subject's Canvas page.
structure.6: Closing: 'Have a great weekend!' then 'Mr. Reagan'

mustNot: summarize only part of the agenda
rebuild the agenda separately from the verified page
invent information not present in the page/fact packet
replace the full agenda with a link

q2w1AuditResult.finding: The four Q2W1 weekly-update announcements (Math 166383, Reading/Spelling 166384, Language Arts 166385, Science 166386) contained only the transition sentence and OMITTED the full agenda.
q2w1AuditResult.remediation: update each existing announcement in place to embed the complete verified agenda; do not create duplicate announcements
